note: Family-run campground on the Martiny Chain of Lakes near Mecosta; mostly seasonal sites, with a few nightly RV sites, tent sites, cabins and rental campers; boat moorings and kayaks for rent. --Claude
summary: Operator site (403 to curl, read in the browser) + Park With Us booking page: campsites $40/night (undated page, 2026 season banner), 50 A + water at sites, dump station, bath houses; season ended Oct 12, 2026, next season's booking opens May 7. flags: Mostly seasonal: the Park With Us site list for RV sites shows about 53 of 58 as seasonal sites (named 'Seasonal Site NN' or 'S-NN <holder name>'), only 2 ('Rental Site 30', 'Rental Site 56') bookable nightly online, plus 3 non-bookable 'Rental Site A-C' (read 2026-10-22).
